faq: What is the difference between NativePHP and TypePHP?

TypePHP is an ahead-of-time compiler that turns typed PHP into C++ and then native code for speed. NativePHP is an app framework that embeds the normal PHP runtime in iOS, Android and desktop apps. One makes PHP faster; the other puts PHP in apps.

Which native PHP tool is production ready?
As of November 2026, NativePHP (Mobile v4, Desktop v2) is the stable one. elephc (v0.27.8) and TypePHP are experimental compilers best used for isolated modules.
Will elephc or TypePHP speed up my Laravel app?
Not as a whole. Both compile a typed subset of PHP, and framework code is too dynamic. Profile first, use Octane or FrankenPHP for boot and concurrency, and compile only a proven CPU-bound module.
